answers.core: All the developers who are working on 3D games with Godot must have encountered the problem of sudden crashes in the released version of the game on a regular basis. With the addition of this feature, game crashes will be identified one by one.
answers.workaround: Having this feature made will definitely be used a lot, as the game is bound to experience crashes anyway! There's no way to fix this crash problem if you just close the app without any information.

title: Add a GUI dialog that pops up when the engine crashes
